title: Claude scheduled tasks: cloud, local and loop limits
h1: claude scheduled tasks: which kind are you using?
description: Untangle Claude Cowork tasks, Claude Code cloud schedules, desktop local tasks and /loop, with current plans, limits and ten prompt ideas.
keywords: claude cowork scheduled tasks not working
answer: **get the brief while your laptop is still shut.** current cowork schedules run remotely as of 12 november 2026. claude code also has cloud schedules, desktop local tasks and an open-session loop. they need different setups. find the kind you used first: changing laptop sleep settings won't fix a cloud job, while a local job still needs that laptop awake.

review.by: lead agent: independent reviewer pass against seo/facts (4 reviewers), every finding applied, automated gate

og_line: four meanings of a scheduled task.

sections.h: current cowork schedules keep going remotely
sections.md:
**your current cowork schedule can run while you sleep.** saved prompts run remotely on a schedule or on demand. pro, max, ultra, team and enterprise support them; free does not.[^1]

manual setup offers hourly, daily, weekly, weekdays and manual. each run starts its own cowork session and can use connectors, skills and plugins.[^1]

older tasks created before 6 october 2026 can still run locally. open yours to see where it lives. scheduled tasks cannot use linked personal finance accounts.[^1]

sections.h: claude code has three other meanings of schedule
sections.md:
**pick the schedule that can reach your work.** claude code offers cloud, desktop and loop, each with its own behaviour.[^2][^3][^4]

- code cloud schedules, formerly routines, package prompts, repositories and connectors
- local tasks in the desktop app need the app open and computer awake
- `/loop` repeats a prompt inside an open code session

loop needs the machine on and has a minimum interval of one minute.[^4] the [code routines guide](/guides/claude-code-routines) covers cloud setup and its separate limits.

sections.h: match your plan to where you want to work
sections.md:
**see which features your plan gives you on the phone.** as of 12 november 2026, cowork web and mobile support pro, max, ultra and team. team access is beta.[^6]

claude desktop supports macos, windows and linux beta on all paid plans. schedules support pro, max, ultra, team and enterprise.[^1][^6]

new pro, max and ultra cowork tasks run in the cloud. the local-only option went away on 6 october 2026.[^6] try the task with its source files before leaving it unattended.

sections.h: ten jobs that have a reason to repeat
sections.md:
**put the work that changes on a schedule.** point these prompts at a connected app or a folder the task can read.

1. monday: read new product briefs in the brief folder. list three open questions per brief.
2. mornings: read new experiment results in the tracker. suggest one next test per result.
3. friday: find conflicting dates in the current milestone sheet.
4. weekdays: read new policy drafts in the review folder. explain one unclear clause per draft.
5. sunday: read changed business-plan files. challenge one changed assumption.
6. tuesday: read new interview notes. suggest one unanswered customer question.
7. monthly: find active project constraints that need a fresh decision.
8. thursday: read new pitch drafts. suggest a simpler opening for each.
9. evenings: read the current study file. test me on vocabulary still marked for practice.
10. wednesday: read new documents awaiting review. propose a short checklist for each.

name the source and output length. tell it what to do if files are missing. if nothing changed, ask for one quiet line.

**find the failed step before rebuilding the setup.** open the task's schedule, time zone and usage account. local jobs need the host and app awake. for a cloud job, look at the remote run.

in dusk, ask a named bot for a routine. its card shows upcoming runs; **automations** shows history. local dusk routines still need an awake host.[^5]

provider terms and usage allowances follow you between schedulers. read current terms before unattended work. the [scheduler comparison](/scheduled-ai-tasks) helps once you know which failure you need to fix.

faq.q: can a scheduled task use my personal finance accounts?
faq.a: **no, not through scheduled tasks.** anthropic excludes linked personal finance accounts as of 12 november 2026. access elsewhere in claude does not carry over.[^1]

faq.q: why are claude scheduled tasks not working when my laptop sleeps?
faq.a: **a local task needs that laptop.** code desktop needs the app open and computer awake. current cowork and code cloud schedules run remotely; older cowork tasks may remain local.[^1][^2][^3]

faq.q: are claude code routines and scheduled tasks different?
faq.a: **code cloud routines changed names.** as of 12 november 2026, they are cloud scheduled tasks. that does not make them cowork tasks or session loops.[^2][^4]
